rules.description: Each physical slot can hold only one container footprint; long boxes reserve both supporting cells.
rules.source: expert; project/synthetic assumptions recorded in src/stowage/rules/catalogue.toml

rules.description: Each container must fit the size and supporting-cell geometry of its assigned slot.
rules.source: expert; project/synthetic assumptions recorded in src/stowage/rules/catalogue.toml

rules.description: Do not support a 20-foot box on a 40-foot box (conservative project rule).
rules.source: expert; project/synthetic assumptions recorded in src/stowage/rules/catalogue.toml

rules.description: Keep each stack within its declared mass limit, including existing cargo.
rules.source: expert; project/synthetic assumptions recorded in src/stowage/rules/catalogue.toml

rules.description: Keep stack height, including high cubes, within vessel and hatch clearances.
rules.source: expert; project/synthetic assumptions recorded in src/stowage/rules/catalogue.toml

rules.description: Place refrigerated containers only where compatible powered plugs are available.
rules.source: expert; project/synthetic assumptions recorded in src/stowage/rules/catalogue.toml

rules.description: Require legal access for current discharges; later-port restow lifts are projected counts, not an executable future plan.
rules.source: expert; project/synthetic assumptions recorded in src/stowage/rules/catalogue.toml

rules.description: Require legal current hatch access and count projected future blocker and hatch-cover lifts.
rules.source: expert; project/synthetic assumptions recorded in src/stowage/rules/catalogue.toml

rules.description: Require valid verified container masses before stowage.
rules.source: SOLAS; SOLAS VI/2; MSC.380(94); MSC.1/Circ.1475, VI/2

rules.description: Keep yard stacks within the effective block, port and handling-equipment height limits.
rules.source: expert; Expert written answers, 28 Oct 2026, Q3; docs/decisions.md, D61/D62/D64; Addendum 1 A3-A5

rules.description: Keep on-deck tiers within the current or later call’s declared crane reach.
rules.source: expert; Expert written answers, 28 Oct 2026, Q3; docs/decisions.md, D61/D62/D64; Addendum 1 A3-A5

rules.description: Keep the ship’s draught within the port or berth limit for the call.
rules.source: port; docs/decisions.md, D61/D62/D64; Addendum 1 A3-A5

rules.description: Require the vessel’s length to fit the port’s declared limit.
rules.source: port; docs/decisions.md, D61/D62/D64; Addendum 1 A3-A5

rules.description: Lift blocking top cargo before accessing a box beneath it.
rules.source: expert; project/synthetic assumptions recorded in src/stowage/rules/catalogue.toml

rules.description: Clear the hatch cover and open it before accessing the hold below.
rules.source: expert; project/synthetic assumptions recorded in src/stowage/rules/catalogue.toml

rules.description: Fill ship stacks from the bottom with physically supported placements.
rules.source: expert; project/synthetic assumptions recorded in src/stowage/rules/catalogue.toml

rules.description: Withhold certification if a required checker component fails; report a diagnostic, not physical infeasibility.
rules.source: user specification (D62); src/stowage/checker/full.py, src/stowage/model and docs/decisions.md, D11; D68; checker/full.py existing emitted contract

rules.description: Withhold certification when required vessel evidence is missing.
rules.source: user specification (D62); src/stowage/checker/full.py, src/stowage/model and docs/decisions.md, D11; D68; checker/full.py existing emitted contract

rules.description: Reject invalid declared ballast masses or tank references without claiming no feasible ballast exists.
rules.source: user specification (D62); src/stowage/checker/full.py, src/stowage/model and docs/decisions.md, D11; D68; checker/full.py existing emitted contract

rules.description: Require every box on the declared load list to be aboard in the completed departure plan.
rules.source: user specification (D62); src/stowage/checker/full.py, src/stowage/model and docs/decisions.md, D11; D68; checker/full.py existing emitted contract

rules.description: Separate incompatible dangerous-goods classes using the IMDG general segregation table.
rules.source: IMDG; IMO MSC.556(108), IMDG Code Amendment 42-24, 7.2.4

rules.description: Apply container-ship dangerous-goods separation for deck position, container type and hold geometry.
rules.source: IMDG; IMO MSC.556(108), IMDG Code Amendment 42-24, 7.4.3

rules.description: Honour each supported dangerous-goods entry’s deck, heat, accommodation and special-segregation restrictions.
rules.source: IMDG; IMO MSC.556(108), IMDG Code Amendment 42-24, 3.2; IMO MSC.556(108), IMDG Code Amendment 42-24, 3.2 and 7.1; IMO MSC.556(108), IMDG Code Amendment 42-24, 7.1.2

rules.description: Keep total ship mass within the declared vessel loading limits.
rules.source: IS Code; project/synthetic assumptions recorded in src/stowage/rules/catalogue.toml

rules.description: Keep the ship’s draught within its declared vessel limits.
rules.source: IS Code; project/synthetic assumptions recorded in src/stowage/rules/catalogue.toml

rules.description: Keep corrected initial stability above the vessel loading-manual minimum.
rules.source: IS Code; project/synthetic assumptions recorded in src/stowage/rules/catalogue.toml

rules.description: Account for the destabilising movement of liquids in partially filled tanks.
rules.source: IS Code; IMO MSC.267(85), 2008 Intact Stability Code, B 3.1; mandatory through A 2.1.2

rules.description: Require enough accumulated righting ability up to 30 degrees of heel.
rules.source: IS Code; IMO MSC.267(85), 2008 Intact Stability Code, A 2.2.1

rules.description: Require enough accumulated righting ability up to 40 degrees or the flooding limit.
rules.source: IS Code; IMO MSC.267(85), 2008 Intact Stability Code, A 2.2.1

rules.description: Require enough additional righting ability between 30 degrees and 40 degrees or the flooding limit.
rules.source: IS Code; IMO MSC.267(85), 2008 Intact Stability Code, A 2.2.1

rules.description: Require sufficient restoring leverage at or beyond 30 degrees of heel.
rules.source: IS Code; IMO MSC.267(85), 2008 Intact Stability Code, A 2.2.2

rules.description: Require peak restoring leverage to occur at 25 degrees of heel or later.
rules.source: IS Code; IMO MSC.267(85), 2008 Intact Stability Code, A 2.2.3

rules.description: Keep corrected initial stability above the Intact Stability Code minimum.
rules.source: IS Code; IMO MSC.267(85), 2008 Intact Stability Code, A 2.2.4

rules.description: Check resistance to the Code’s prescribed severe wind and rolling scenario.
rules.source: IS Code; IMO MSC.267(85), 2008 Intact Stability Code, A 2.3; IMO MSC.267(85), 2008 Intact Stability Code, A 2.3.4, table 2.3.4-3

rules.description: Apply the project’s additional containership righting-ability check where its declared scope applies.
rules.source: IS Code; IMO MSC.267(85), 2008 Intact Stability Code, B 2.3; IMO MSC.267(85), 2008 Intact Stability Code, B 2.3.2

rules.description: Keep the difference between bow and stern draught within loading-manual limits.
rules.source: IS Code; project/synthetic assumptions recorded in src/stowage/rules/catalogue.toml

rules.description: Keep the ship’s sideways lean within loading-manual limits.
rules.source: IS Code; project/synthetic assumptions recorded in src/stowage/rules/catalogue.toml

rules.description: Keep every open hatch coaming above the actual waterline; a wet opening cannot be certified.
rules.source: expert; project/synthetic assumptions recorded in src/stowage/rules/catalogue.toml

rules.description: Keep shear force and bending moment within station limits, including prescribed wave loads and applicable torsion.
rules.source: IACS; IACS UR S11A (revision currency unconfirmed), S11A.1.1.2(i); IACS UR S11A (revision currency unconfirmed), scope

rules.description: Require strength read-outs at declared loading-instrument stations; this is not class approval.
rules.source: IACS; IACS UR S1 rev.7 (latest to confirm), loading instrument requirement

rules.description: Keep the bridge’s forward sea view and blind sectors within applicable SOLAS limits.
rules.source: SOLAS; SOLAS V/22; MSC.99(73); MSC.1/Circ.1350/Rev.1, V/22.1

rules.description: Check securing and container force limits using the disclosed approximate lashing-demand model.
rules.source: IACS; Indian Register of Shipping, Guidelines on Container Securing, July 2025 (IACS member guidance), published force limits and stiffness; page verification pending

rules.description: Put heavy-class boxes under deck unless no compatible hold cell remains empty at departure.
rules.source: expert; project/synthetic assumptions recorded in src/stowage/rules/catalogue.toml

rules.description: Keep heavy-class boxes low; inherited Stage B ordering breaches alone may be tolerated.
rules.source: expert; project/synthetic assumptions recorded in src/stowage/rules/catalogue.toml

rules.description: Do not place a heavier mass class above a lighter class; same-class masses may be in any order.
rules.source: expert; project/synthetic assumptions recorded in src/stowage/rules/catalogue.toml

rules.description: Honour a container’s binding request to travel below deck.
rules.source: expert; project/synthetic assumptions recorded in src/stowage/rules/catalogue.toml

rules.description: Honour a container’s binding request to travel on deck.
rules.source: expert; project/synthetic assumptions recorded in src/stowage/rules/catalogue.toml

rules.description: Honour heat-separation requests using declared heat sources and the provisional clearance.
rules.source: expert; IMDG Code Amendment 42-24 (MSC.556(108)); data/raw/imdg-42-24/msc556-108.txt around line 42089, 7.1.2, definition: Protected from sources of heat

rules.description: Honour a container’s binding request for a top-of-stack position.
rules.source: expert; project/synthetic assumptions recorded in src/stowage/rules/catalogue.toml

rules.description: Put over-height cargo at the top and check its declared vertical clearance.
rules.source: expert; project/synthetic assumptions recorded in src/stowage/rules/catalogue.toml

rules.description: Keep occupied neighbours clear of an oversized container’s declared physical envelope.
rules.source: expert; project/synthetic assumptions recorded in src/stowage/rules/catalogue.toml
